integrity: A complete finite computation gives an integral homotopy proof; numerical Betti rank 84 was previously published and is not claimed as original. Same-model review only; independent validation absent.
scientific_limitations: Single P4 Cartesian P4 grid; only rational dihedral representation specified, no integral module or equivariant homotopy equivalence.
title: Integral homotopy and dihedral character of the four-by-four grid total four-cut complex
